Q.name: Chomp
Q.title: Template:Data Trundle/Chomp
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Chomp|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Trundle
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Chomp.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{cis|Trundle}} next {{tip|basic attack}} within a few seconds will deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and briefly {{tip|slow}} the target.
|blurb2      = Afterwards, '''Trundle''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} for a few seconds, during which he reduces the target's {{as|attack damage}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Trundle''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 7 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|25 '''bonus''' range}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|slow}} the target by 75% for {{fd|0.1}} seconds.
|leveling     = {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|10 to 90}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15 to 55}}% AD)}}}}
|description2 = After using the empowered attack, '''Trundle''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} for 5 seconds and reduces the target's {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} by half that amount for the same duration.
|leveling2    = {{st|Bonus Attack Damage|{{ap|20 to 40}}}}
{{st|Attack Damage Reduction|{{ap|20/2 to 40/2}}}}
|description3 = ''Chomp {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Trundle's''' basic attack timer.''
|cooldown     = {{fd|3.5}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = 20
|costtype     = Mana 
|targeting    = Auto
|cast time    = none
|damagetype   = Physical
|spelleffects = spell
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|spellshield  = special
|parry       = Special
|notes   = 
* ''Chomp'' will still incur the {{sti|{{as|attack damage}}}} increase for '''Trundle''' even if the attack is {{tip|dodged}}, {{tip|blocked}}, missed while he is {{tip|blind|blinded}}, or it is blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block the attack damage reduction and {{tip|slow}}.
* If the attack damage reduction would reduce the target's {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} below {{as|0|ad}}, the target's {{as|'''base''' attack damage}} value is unaffected, but their {{as|'''total''' attack damage}} will still be reduced. The target will however retain a {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} value of 0.
** Effects that scale with {{as|'''total''' attack damage}}, such as basic attacks, will take the attack damage reduction into account for their calculations.
*** Those that have a ratio for {{as|'''base''' attack damage}} or {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} do not take the reduction into account.
}}

R.name: Subjugate
R.title: Template:Data Trundle/Subjugate
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Subjugate|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Trundle
|skill        = R
|icon         = Subjugate.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Trundle}} drains the life force of the target enemy champion, dealing {{as|magic damage}} based on {{as|their '''maximum''' health}} and {{tip|heal|healing}} for the same amount. He also steals a portion of their {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resist}}}}, and increases in {{tip|size}} while reducing their {{tip|size}}.
|blurb2      = Half of the damage and stealing is applied instantly, and the other half is applied over a few seconds. The {{as|armor}} and {{as|magic resist}} will remain stolen for a few seconds afterwards.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Trundle''' drains the life force out of the target enemy champion, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|heal|healing}} himself for the same amount. He also reduces 40% of their '''current''' {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}}, while gaining the same amount reduced as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, respectively, for himself. Additionally, he increases in {{tip|size}} by 18% while reducing the target's size by {{fd|9.9}}%.
|leveling     = {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|20 to 30}}% {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health|health}}}}
{{st|Total Healing|{{as|{{ap|20 to 30}}% {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health|health}}}}
|description2 = Half of the drain's '''total''' damage, healing, and resistances reduction is applied on-cast, while the other half is applied every second over the next 4 seconds. The size modifiers last for 8 seconds and are applied over the first {{fd|2.25}} seconds of the duration, both increasing '''Trundle's''' size by 2% and reducing the target's size by {{fd|1.1}}% every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
|leveling2    = {{st|Initial Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|20/2 to 30/2}}% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health|health}}|Magic Damage Per Second|{{as|{{ap|20/8 to 30/8}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.25}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health|health}}}}
{{st|Initial Healing|{{as|{{ap|20/2 to 30/2}}% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health|health}}|Healing Per Second|{{as|{{ap|20/8 to 30/8}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.25}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health|health}}}}
|description3 = The resistances reduction on the target will linger for 4 seconds after the drain has ended.
|cooldown     = {{ap|120 to 80}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = Mana
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 650
|targeting    = Unit
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = magic
|spelleffects = special
|spellshield  = True
|callforhelp  = True
|notes        = 
* ''Subjugate'' deals {{tip|persistent damage}}, additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage}}, and applies {{tip|spell effects}}.
* ''Subjugate'' will snapshot the values of the target's '''current''' {{as|'''maximum''' health}}, {{as|'''total''' armor}}, and {{as|'''total''' magic resistance}} as soon as it completes its cast. The drain debuff will calculate the remaining half of the damage, healing, and resistances reduction based on these snapshotted values, even if the target's health or resistances change. The snapshot lasts until the debuff expires.
* The target's resistances will be further reduced by 5% per drain tick, up to 20% by the end of the drain (totaling to 40% reduction from the initial 20% reduction on-cast).
* '''Trundle''' will gain the reduced resistances of the target for himself for as long as they remain reduced, including while they are lingering after the drain.
* The resistances gained is based on the current reduced resistances of the target; the total amount that would be reduced is not granted to '''Trundle''' all at once. In other words, he will initially gain 20% of the target's resistances, then the remaining 20% over the 4 seconds, gaining additional bonus resistances equal to the resistances reduced per drain tick.
* '''Trundle''' gains {{fd|11.7}} extra {{sti|range}} on his {{tip|basic attacks}} (relative to his and enemy center) as a consequence of his increased {{tip|size}}.
** So do his enemies.
** He gains {{fd|3.78}} to {{fd|6.255}} range against the target he ''subjugated'', depending on their base size, and so does the target against him.
* The debuff on the target also ''persists through death''.
* '''Trundle''' will lose the buff if the target loses the debuff, for example if it enters {{tip|resurrection}}.{{bug|2}}
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}
}}
